libs.note: BH-9594, the BH-9555 contract. The could-not-read classifier and recorder (docs/GH-REST.md §17, docs/STATE-STORES.md box_read_failures). bin/orphan-reconcile.sh calls lib_env_apply could-not-read <project> in a subshell, so a fail-closed exit there never stops the lane.

knobs.zero_means: off: cnr_record posts nothing and prints nothing; every caller logs and declines exactly as before
knobs.note: Kill row of cnr_record (POST /api/box-read-failures). 1 = a could-not-read GitHub read is recorded against the box and an ok read resets the box's count. No shadow mode. Read as ${CNR_ENFORCE:-1}. Rows: lib.could-not-read.<project>.cnr_enforce, then lib.could-not-read.cnr_enforce (seeded 1).
